commits.comment: DSV4 稀疏 MLA 的大型端到端修复。核心变更：(1) cooperative_topk/persistent_topk CUDA kernel 对负数 seq_len 做 clamp，避免 uint32 回绕成 ~4e9 导致越界读；(2) DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata 新增 decode_swa_width 字段，区分 DSpark 非因果填充后的索引宽度与逻辑 window_size；(3) 新增 get_dspark_swa_index_width() 统一 64 对齐宽度计算；(4) build_flashinfer_mixed_sparse_indices kernel 改用 SWA_INDEX_WIDTH 布局；(5) DFlash speculator 对拒绝后缀做 PAD 处理并禁止写入 null block (block 0)；(6) WorkspaceManager 引入 num_lanes 多通道，保证 DSpark target 与 draft CUDA graph 同时持有 workspace 视图；(7) SM120 FlashInfer 能力检查改为精确匹配 dispatch 表。风险点：decode_swa_width 默认值为 0，所有构造 DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata 的 builder 必须显式填充；workspace lane 未初始化时 get_simultaneous 会抛 RuntimeError。

ascend_impact.functionality: 命中 vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py（NPUModelRunner 继承的 GPUModelRunner）与注意力后端共享模块。DeepseekSparseSWAMetadata 新增 decode_swa_width 字段（默认 0），vllm-ascend 的 AscendMLA/DSA 等基于该元数据类的后端必须按本 commit 中 ROCm 后端的修复模式填充 decode_swa_width（非因果 DSpark 时使用 get_dspark_swa_index_width），否则非因果宽度计算错误；WorkspaceManager/init_workspace_manager 新增 num_lanes 参数，NPUWorker 若复用共享 WorkspaceManager 并在 DSpark 场景下调用 use_workspace_lane(1)，必须按 _num_workspace_lanes 逻辑初始化 2 条 lane，否则 get_simultaneous 抛 RuntimeError；indexer.py 的 seq_len clamp 修复为共享正确性修复，Ascend 一并受益。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 应验证其 MLA/DSA 元数据构建在 decode_swa_width 缺失时不会静默产生错误形状，以及 DSpark 场景下 workspace lane 初始化与 model runner 行为。

affected_interfaces: NPUWorker.init_device (vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py) — calls init_workspace_manager(self.device, num_ubatches) without the new num_lanes parameter; upstream GPUWorker now configures 2 workspace lanes for DSpark+v2

AscendDFlashSpeculator / _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py) — Ascend-maintained fork of the upstream triton kernel, patched via vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_triton.py; lacks the new rejected-suffix and null-block fixes

AscendDSparkSpeculator (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dspark/speculator.py) — inherits DSparkSpeculator whose propose/capture/load_model now execute inside use_workspace_lane(1) in inherited GPUModelRunner code

AscendDSAMetadataBuilder / build_dspark_swa_indices / _aligned_dspark_index_width (vllm_ascend/attention/dsa_v1.py) — DSpark SWA index-width alignment (128) now diverges from upstream get_dspark_swa_index_width (64)

NPUModelRunner v2 (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py) — inherits GPUModelRunner.load_model/_dummy_run/capture/execute_model which now wrap speculator calls in use_workspace_lane(self._draft_workspace_lane)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1) Workspace lanes: In NPUWorker.init_device (vllm_ascend/worker/worker.py:463) and XliteWorker.init_device (vllm_ascend/xlite/xlite_worker.py:29), mirror GPUWorker's new logic and pass num_lanes = 2 when use_v2_model_runner and speculative_config.use_dspark() (else 1): init_workspace_manager(self.device, num_ubatches, num_lanes). Without this, DSpark target/draft ops run inside use_workspace_lane(1) while the manager has only 1 lane — currently harmless only because Ascend attention backends never call get_simultaneous(), but it silently drops the DSpark workspace-aliasing fix and risks a RuntimeError('Workspace lane 1 is not configured') the moment any draft-path code touches the workspace manager. 2) DFlash kernel sync: Update _prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel_ascend in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/speculator.py to match the new upstream semantics: (a) clamp context loads/stores to [0, valid_ctx_end - ctx_start) so rejected-suffix rows write position 0 + PAD_SLOT_ID instead of real draft KV (contamination bug fixed upstream), and (b) force rows whose ctx_block_id or q_block_id == 0 (null/physical block 0) to PAD_SLOT_ID so draft KV never writes the null block. Verify DFlashCudaGraphManager/DFlashAclGraphManager capture paths (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/spec_decode/dflash/aclgraph.py) tolerate the -1 sample_idx_mapping initialization inherited from DFlashSpeculator.__init__. 3) Optionally align dsa_v1.py's _aligned_dspark_index_width alignment (currently 128) with upstream get_dspark_swa_index_width (alignment 64) to keep DSpark SWA index widths consistent with upstream metadata; not a hard break since Ascend uses its own AscendDSAMetadataBuilder. 4) No action needed for the flashinfer/cuda/AMD/NVIDIA/FlashInfer-CUTLASS MoE/csrc changes — those paths are not used by Ascend.
deep_analysis.risk: medium. If the workspace-lane configuration is not added, DSpark v2 speculative decoding on NPU either silently misses the upstream workspace-aliasing fix or raises a RuntimeError if any workspace get_simultaneous call is introduced on the draft lane. If the Ascend DFlash kernel is not synced, DSpark/DFlash DSV4 sparse MLA decode can still write rejected-suffix rows and null-block (physical block 0) slots into draft KV, producing corrupted K/V and incorrect generations — the exact bugs this commit fixes on GPU. The SWA width alignment divergence (128 vs 64) is lower risk since Ascend builds its own metadata, but should be kept consistent to avoid future shape mismatches when DSpark draft and target metadata are combined.

commits.message:
[MRV2] Support attention-free models (#52374)

Signed-off-by: Nick Hill <nickhill123@gmail.com>

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: 1. Mirror the upstream init_model_state change in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/__init__.py:init_asecnd_model_state (line 37): change the condition from `if vllm_config.model_config.is_hybrid:` to `if vllm_config.model_config.is_hybrid or vllm_config.model_config.is_attention_free:` so that attention-free models (pure Mamba/SSM with no attention layers) are routed to AscendMambaHybridModelState instead of AscendModelState. 2. Verify AscendMambaHybridModelState (vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_states/mamba_hybrid.py:36, which inherits upstream MambaHybridModelState + AscendModelState) correctly handles attention-free models on NPU: it inherits MambaHybridAttnMetadata construction (num_accepted_tokens, num_decode_draft_tokens_cpu used by Mamba2AttentionMetadataBuilder/GDNAttentionMetadataBuilder) and the align-mode state pre/postprocessing; confirm the triton kernels used (preprocess_mamba_align_fused_kernel, _scatter/_fill_num_accepted_kernel in vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_states/mamba_hybrid.py) and MambaSpecDecodeGPUContext already run on NPU for pure-mamba models as they do for hybrid mamba models. 3. Optionally add an e2e test for an attention-free model under VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 on NPU. 4. The GPUModelRunner.shutdown() addition of `self.cudagraph_manager = None` is inherited by NPUModelRunnerV2 (no override); this plain attribute assignment is safe, but confirm no NPU code later dereferences cudagraph_manager after shutdown in multi-model/RL sleep-wake scenarios.
deep_analysis.risk: Low risk. The main risk is that without the one-line condition change in init_asecnd_model_state, attention-free models silently fall back to AscendModelState and either crash or produce incorrect output (missing mamba state migration, missing num_accepted_tokens/num_decode_draft_tokens_cpu metadata for the mamba attention backend). This only affects MRV2 with attention-free models; hybrid models (Qwen3-Next etc.) are unaffected. A secondary consideration: if NPU lacks support for the align-mode triton kernels used by MambaHybridModelState, attention-free model runs on NPU would fail, so hardware verification of the mamba kernels is required before enabling.

commits.comment: Rust gRPC Control 服务新增 RL 生命周期控制：在 control.proto 中新增 PauseGeneration/ResumeGeneration/IsPaused、Sleep/WakeUp/IsSleeping、InitWeightTransferEngine/StartWeightUpdate/StartDraftWeightUpdate/UpdateWeights/FinishWeightUpdate/UpdateWeightVersion/GetWeightVersion 等 RPC，ServerInfo 增加 RlCapabilities。Python 侧 EngineCoreReadyResponse 新增 weight_transfer_backend/enable_sleep_mode/supports_draft_weight_updates 字段；WorkerBase 新增 supports_draft_weight_updates() 默认返回 False，GPUWorker 根据 weight_transfer_engine 与 draft model 是否存在实现该能力；Executor 通过 collective_rpc 聚合 worker 能力；EngineCoreProc 在握手响应中填充新字段；gRPC service 以 Mutex 串行化 RL 生命周期调用，并校验 sleep mode/weight transfer 配置与 JSON payload。整体为向后兼容的增量接口扩展。

ascend_impact.functionality: 命中 vllm/v1/worker/worker_base.py（NPUWorker 继承的 WorkerBase，新增 supports_draft_weight_updates() 默认方法，不破坏编译）与 vllm/v1/executor/abstract.py（Executor 新增默认实现）。EngineCoreReadyResponse 新增字段均有默认值，握手协议向后兼容；NPUWorker 未覆写 supports_draft_weight_updates 时默认返回 False，行为安全。vllm-ascend 的 sleep mode（CaMem）能力来自 model_config.enable_sleep_mode，握手字段会自动反映；若未来 Ascend 支持 draft 权重更新，需在 NPUWorker 中覆写 supports_draft_weight_updates 并与 weight_transfer_engine 对接。
ascend_impact.testing: 无强制测试需求；Ascend 的 sleep/wakeup 与握手字段可通过现有 engine 测试覆盖。

commits.comment: 该 commit 为 Kimi K3 模型在 AttnRes（attention residual）路径下新增可选的 DFlash 辅助状态捕获方式。默认行为不变，仍由 prefix_sum + hidden_states 得到 aux hidden state；设置 VLLM_KIMI_K3_AUX_ATTN_RES_STREAM=1 后，_capture_aux_hidden_stream() 会调用 attn_res kernel 计算 pre-norm AttnRes mixture（不写 delta、不写 block、不做 output norm）作为 drafter 的输入。实现上根据 layer_idx+1 < end_layer 选择下一层或输出侧 norm/proj 权重，非最后 rank 的最后层则安全回退为 prefix。测试覆盖了开关关闭、权重选择、last rank 回退和 forward 参数映射。风险较低：功能默认关闭，仅影响 Kimi K3 NVIDIA 专用模型与 spec decode 路径；但开启后 drafter 看到的新数值可能影响输出质量，需要实际评估。

ascend_impact.functionality: 无影响。变更集中在 vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/ 的 NVIDIA 专有模型实现和 Kimi K3 相关 env，未触碰 vLLM 平台抽象、Worker、AttentionBackend、KVCacheSpec、DeviceCommunicator 等 Ascend 依赖的接口；vllm-ascend 当前不包含 Kimi K3 模型实现，也不会导入该 NVIDIA 专属路径。
ascend_impact.testing: 无影响。新增/修改的测试均属于 Kimi K3 NVIDIA 模型单测，不涉及 vllm-ascend 测试体系。
